استؤنيت (form X)

# اُسْتُؤْنِيتَ (ustuʔnīta) /us.tuʔ.niː.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# اُسْتُؤْنِيتِ (ustuʔnīti) /us.tuʔ.niː.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# اُسْتُؤْنِيَتْ (ustuʔniyat) /us.tuʔ.ni.jat/:
